messages:
ci-bot: AUTOMERGE ALERT: pipeline 'main' turned RED after merge. failing job: e2e-gpu-smoke (task 4827). first failure seen in runtime-kv-cache integration. logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4827 :rotating_light:

mike: @anya was the author/approver on that PR, right? who took the merge? :eyes:

anya: i approved #3145 earlier, yep. i can take a quick look. any chance this is infra?

raj: can someone paste the failing log snippet? quick grep would help.

ci-bot: failing log excerpt: "AssertionError: KVCache mismatch at step 12 -- alloc 0x7f... \n  GPU used 98% before OOM". full logs above.

sara: okay can we try a rerun first? i'll trigger a rebuild of the job (non-blocking).

mike: thanks — rerun kicked via CI UI (rerun id 2158000100).

ci-bot: rerun started (id 2158000100).

ci-bot: rerun finished -> FAILED. same OOM in runtime-kv-cache.

anya: two failures back-to-back. sounds like a regression in PR or image change. did the base image bump go out with the merge?

raj: i'm seeing a container base-image update in the pipeline image-bake job at 2157998000 (2 hrs ago). might be related.

oncall-ing: infra note: nodepool-usw2-gpu had a rolling kernel update at 03:05 UTC, drains ended ~03:12. no errors reported but could affect device pinning.

anya: thanks. plan: (1) raj — can you run a quick bisect between pre-merge sha 1234567 and merge sha abcdef0 to see when the test started failing? (2) sara — open a rollback/hold on the image-bake if bisect points to that. i'll look at logs for any new allocator changes in the runtime.

raj: on it. i'll run bisect by replaying the job in CI for a few commits and report back within 30m.

sara: copying a short command to rerun a single flaky test locally if helpful:

```
# run smoke e2e locally (docker)
CI_ENV=staging ./scripts/run_e2e.sh --job e2e-gpu-smoke --limit 1
```

anya: nice, thanks. if anyone can try repro locally that would speed things up.

mike: adding :thumbsup: to the plan. i'll notify the release manager to pause any further merges into main until we have root cause or a rollback.

ci-bot: digests saved for failing runs: 4827 / 2158000100. tagging thread with `ci:postmerge` and `priority:high`.

raj: bisect update: first suspect commit (image bump) reproduces failure consistently. will escalate with exact commit in 10m.

anya: good catch. sara please open rollback PR for the image-bake and i'll prepare a quick revert for the merged PR if needed.

sara: opened rollback ticket https://tickets.redwood.example/ROLLBACK-227 and linked CI runs. cc @release

mike: thanks team. keep updates in this thread. if raj confirms, let's revert image and rerun the pipeline. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
